Digital Marketing & Direct Bookings

Digital Marketing for New Hotels in India

A new hotel should open paid booking campaigns when availability, payment, cancellation and enquiry handling work end to end.

Discuss your project

Build the launch in stages

Start with a verified opening window and useful location information. Open booking campaigns once availability, payment and cancellation handling work across the site and reservation system.

Switch activity as doors open

Replace renders with current photography and check listing details. Monitor guest questions and unsupported expectations so launch messages can be corrected quickly.
